result.rationale: The rescue objective stalls at 0/2 across all 6 turns despite the team repeatedly attempting to reach civilians. The primary blocker is spatial/hostile pressure: Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (29 then 25 damage, dropping to 46 health) and takes reactor environment damage (down to 36), while Security Chen and Imani both take reactor-instability damage each turn they remain in reactor zones. Medic Reyes successfully escorts civilian Sato (turn 3) but then fails to extract because the route to rescue-airlock is blocked by zone capacity (turn 4 contested: target_zone_capacity_lost) and pirates (Captain Veyra and Raider Holt occupy command-deck/junction-cover). Reactor heat climbs monotonically 62→100, and oxygen drains 68→42, while the team is spread across storage/reactor/med zones unable to converge on the airlock. The causal bottleneck is that hostile actors and zone capacity/positioning pressure prevent the team from reaching the rescue-airlock affordance, not a lack of information (civilian locations are known) nor a local policy failure (the team does attempt rescue actions).
